---
name: Documentation Improvement
about: Report a documentation gap, error, or missing example
title: "[DOCS] "
labels: documentation
assignees: ""
---

## What's the issue?

A clear and concise description of the problem: missing documentation, an
error, an outdated example, or a hard-to-follow section.

## Where is it?

Which file(s), section, or page is affected?

- [ ] `docs/...` (e.g. `docs/NES-028-CLI-Reference.md`)
- [ ] `README.md` / `GETTING-STARTED.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Website (`site/content/**`)
- [ ] CLI reference (`docs/cli/**`, regenerated with `naeos docsgen`)
- [ ] Spec / governance / constitution document

## Suggested fix

What should it say instead, or what example is missing?

## Checklist for documentation contributors

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — documentation
      changes still require passing markdown/format checks where enforced.
- [ ] This is a `docs`-only change (no behavior change).
- [ ] I can update related indexes (e.g. [DOCUMENTATION-INDEX.md](../../DOCUMENTATION-INDEX.md)) if the change adds a new document.

## Additional Context

Any links, screenshots, or references that help.
